description.narrative: (LAB - Global Development Lab): .This award will support the GeoCenter's application of geospatial technology, and creation of new data and map-building expertise to help USAID more effectively target its resources in places that need it the most to solve international development challenges. The GeoCenter operations (staff, hardware, mapping and database software, Mission GIS specialist support, satellite imagery services, etc.) support more than 100 requests for technical assistance each year to inform the planning, design and implementation of development programs. GeoCenter operations provides training and capacity building to ensure that USAID can integrate data and analysis into its business operations. This mechanism supports buy-ins from USAID Missions, Bureaus and Independent Offices (M/B/IOs)....
